title: One annoyed stranger is expensive
dek: Not interested, block, mute, and report all pull a post down in the defaults.
whatChanged: In the defaults, not interested is -53.07, block is -31.2, mute is -58.8, and report is -234.0. Report has the largest magnitude in this list. The code comments say these weights multiply predicted probabilities, so they are not counts, and one report is not a fixed number of likes. These are defaults in the public repo, and live settings can differ.
meaningForCreators: Negative actions are rare, so the code weights each one hard. A post that makes strangers reach for not interested or mute can be shown less to people like them. Write the hook to keep the reader, not only to catch attention.
action: Do this: cut any hook that would make a stranger want to mute you, and keep the first line honest about what the post says.
